title: CLI wording and polish: doctor hints, spec sitting and adj prompts
lead: One sweep over `internal/cli` and its docs: twelve small fixes to `ork doctor` upgrade hints, the `ork run` and `ork wave start` spec sitting, and the `ork adj answer` prompt. No daemon, engine or `cmd` change. It folds the later notes of S178 (S188), S167 (S189) and S172 (S200).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The later notes below were reviewed on 2026-10-29 and 2026-10-30 and left for a sweep. The owner decided on 2026-10-31 that later-notes rows fold into sweep slices and the folded rows are retired once the sweep is filed. Each item was re-read against the code at HEAD of main; the line anchors are today's.

Folded in (item numbers are the note's own):

S188 (S178 later notes, doctor and upgrade):
- (2) No test changes the accepted contract set, so a hard-coded min or max in `contractDirection` (`internal/cli/upgrade.go:160`) would pass. Add a seam in `internal/cli`, as `readBuildInfo` is one (`internal/cli/upgrade.go:25`); no `internal/roles` change.
- (4) With `--upgrade` and a current tool the reason is the bare `requested with --upgrade` (`internal/cli/upgrade.go:214`, :226 and :237). It shows the installed version when doctor read one.
- (5) The reason says `older than ork accepts`; it becomes `older than the versions ork accepts` (and `newer than ...`), `internal/cli/upgrade.go:205` and the ork case at :235.
- (6) The ork note reads `ORK_CHECKOUT is your ork checkout` while adj's reads `ADJ_CHECKOUT = your checkout` (`internal/cli/upgrade.go:279,295`). Both use `NAME = your checkout`.
- (7) `docs/design.md` usage block: `ork doctor` is 87 columns and `ork check` 83 (`docs/design.md:1109`, `:1091`). Rewrap to 80.
- (1) in part: a slicer checkout whose venv is not `.venv` is read as a plain venv and gets the PyPI command (`internal/cli/upgrade.go:125-137`, `:252-256`). This slice only adds a note to the venv hint that says the command assumes PyPI and what to run for a checkout. Recognising such a checkout is not done here (open owner question in the manifest).

S189 (S167 later notes, spec sitting):
- (1) At end of input the `held:` line runs onto the prompt line, because `askSpecQuestions` prints a newline only when `err == nil` (`internal/cli/wave.go:341-347`).
- (2) `ork run --json` on a declined start prints `{"started":false}` with no `held` key, while `ork wave start` always has `"held":[]` (`internal/cli/run.go:147`; the wave prints `held` at `internal/cli/wave.go:176,188` and normalises it at :168).
- (3) A text-mode spec-check error is a bare `ork: MESSAGE` for both commands (`internal/cli/wave.go:251`). It gets the prefix `spec check failed: `.
- (4) Role-supplied question and option text is not wrapped to 80 columns (`internal/cli/wave.go:316-347`, shared by both commands).

S200 (S172 later notes, `ork adj`):
- (2) `ork adj answer` prints the record title and option summaries as adj stored them (`internal/cli/adj.go:97-106`); control characters can reach the terminal. They are filtered with `runrec.PlainText` (`internal/runrec/plain.go:23`), the filter the report and render panes use.
- (3) When the input ends without a newline, `cancelled` prints on the prompt line (`internal/cli/adj.go:114-124`). The same happens in `ork run` and `ork wave start` (`internal/cli/run.go:84-97`, `internal/cli/wave.go:120-133`). One helper fixes all three.

Not in this slice (the manifest has the reasons and options):
- S188 (3) a behind hint for adj from its build info: ork does not know the adj checkout path (the hint uses the placeholder `ADJ_CHECKOUT`, `internal/cli/upgrade.go:276`). Dropped.
- S189 (5) whether the daemon's raw `run.start` should read dependencies: that is a daemon change. Left to the owner.
- S200 (1) `adj ask` without `--by` takes the daemon's `ADJ_ASKED_BY` (`../adjudicate/internal/cli/ask.go:79-81`; ork sends `--by` only when set, `internal/adjcli/adjcli.go:215`). How to attribute is an owner choice. Left to the owner.

sections.body:

- `internal/cli/prompt_test.go` (new).
- `internal/cli/upgrade.go` (seam `acceptedContracts`; reasons at :205 and :214; venv note in `slicerHint` at :254-256; ork note at :295).
- `internal/cli/upgrade_test.go` (:330-413 expectations; new tests).
- `internal/cli/wave.go` (`ask` at :120, `specCheck` at :240, `askSpecQuestions` at :316).
- `internal/cli/run.go` (`ask` at :84, the decline JSON at :147, `call` at :19).
- `internal/cli/adj.go` (:97-124).
- `internal/cli/wave_test.go`, `internal/cli/run_test.go`, `internal/cli/adj_test.go`.
- `docs/design.md` (usage block :1091 and :1109; the `ork run` JSON sentence at :1226-1227; the doctor upgrade paragraph at :1405-1431 for the venv note and the reason wording).

This slice is N-class: it names nothing under internal/engine, internal/daemon or cmd. It shares `internal/cli` with the S207 sweep (`internal/cli/cli.go`, `pin.go`, `doctor.go`, `upgrade.go`) and S100 (`internal/cli/cli.go`, `daemoncmds.go`), which run in a later wave; `internal/cli/cli.go` is not edited here.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `internal/cli/prompt_test.go`:

- TestReadLinePrintsANewlineWhenTheInputEnds: input `n` with no newline returns `"n"` and `io.EOF` and writes `"\n"` to the writer; input `n\n` returns `"n\n"` and writes nothing; empty input returns `""`, `io.EOF` and writes `"\n"`. Fails first: no `readLine`.
- TestWrapLinesBreaksAtWordsAndHangs: with width 80 and hang two spaces, no line is longer than 80 runes, words are not split unless one is longer than the width, continuation lines start with the first line's own leading spaces plus two spaces, and the words come back in order.
- TestPlainLineDropsControlCharacters: `"a\x1b[31mb\x07\nc\x85d"` becomes `"ab cd"` (newlines become a space); invalid UTF-8 becomes `?`. Built on `runrec.PlainText`.

In `internal/cli/upgrade_test.go`:

- TestContractDirectionFollowsTheAcceptedSet: with `acceptedContracts` replaced by `{20, 21}` for the test, `Contract: relay v19` gives `(-1, 19)`, `v22` gives `(1, 22)`, `v20` and `v21` give `0`, and a non-contract line gives `(0, 0)`. Fails first: the seam does not exist (compile error), and a hard-coded 10 and 11 would give 1 for v19.
- TestDoctorReasonsNameTheVersionsOrkAccepts: the older and newer reasons read `slicer prints relay v9, older than the versions ork accepts (v10, v11)` and `... newer than the versions ork accepts (v10, v11)`. The two existing expectations at :338 and :401 change to match.
- TestDoctorUpgradeReasonShowsTheInstalledVersion: `doctor --upgrade --json` with a current slicer whose version line is `slicer X` has the reason `requested with --upgrade (installed: slicer X)`; adj likewise; a tool with an empty version keeps `requested with --upgrade`. The ork reason is unchanged.
- TestDoctorCheckoutPlaceholdersUseOneForm: the ork note is `ORK_CHECKOUT = your checkout` and the adj note still starts `ADJ_CHECKOUT = your checkout`.
- TestDoctorVenvHintNotesThePyPIAssumption: the venv slicer hint has the note `PyPI install assumed; a checkout venv needs git pull and pip install -e` and the same commands as before; the note fits 80 columns with its `  note: ` prefix (the existing fit test at :538 covers the printed form).
- TestDesignUsageBlockFitsEightyColumns: reads `../../docs/design.md`, finds the fenced block that contains `ork doctor [--upgrade]` and fails for each line over 80 columns. Fails first: lines 1091 and 1109 are 83 and 87.

In `internal/cli/wave_test.go` and `internal/cli/run_test.go` (use the `stub.call` doubles those files already have):

- TestWaveStartHeldLineStartsOnItsOwnLineAtEOF: input ends at the first spec question; the output contains `): \nheld: S1 has 1 open spec question` and not `): held:`. Same for `ork run`.
- TestRunDeclineJSONHasAnEmptyHeldArray: `ork run --json` answered `n` prints `{"started":false,"held":[]}` on stdout; the held-by-questions case still lists the id and is never `null`.
- TestSpecCheckErrorHasAPrefixInTextMode: when `spec.check` returns a wire error, `ork run` and `ork wave start` print `ork: spec check failed: MESSAGE` on stderr and exit 1; with `--json` the error object carries the daemon's message unchanged.
- TestSpecQuestionsWrapAtEightyColumns: a question with a 200-character title, option summaries and a reason of the same length print no line over 80 columns in either command; continuation lines hang two spaces under the first.
- TestConfirmCancelledStartsOnANewLineWhenInputEndsWithoutNewline: `ork run` and `ork wave start` with input `n` and no newline print `Start this slice? [y/N]: \ncancelled` (and `Start this wave?` for the wave).

In `internal/cli/adj_test.go`:

- TestAdjAnswerFiltersControlCharactersInRecordText: an open record whose title holds `\x1b[31m` and `\x07` and whose option summary holds `\r` prints none of `\x1b`, `\x07`, `\r` or a C1 character (U+0080 to U+009F), and keeps the visible words.
- TestAdjAnswerCancelledStartsOnANewLineAtEOF: input `n` with no newline prints `[y/N] \ncancelled`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests first and run them; each must fail for the reason given above.
2. `internal/cli/prompt.go`:
   - `readLine(in *bufio.Reader, w io.Writer) (string, error)`: `in.ReadString('\n')`; when the error is `io.EOF` write `"\n"` to `w`; return the line and the error unchanged, so callers keep their `line == "" && err == nil` logic.
   - `wrapLines(text string, width int, hang string) []string`: greedy word wrap by rune count (no East Asian width handling); the first line keeps its leading spaces; continuation lines start with those spaces plus `hang`.
   - `plainLine(s string) string`: `strings.Join(strings.Fields(runrec.PlainText(s)), " ")`.
   - `(a *App) callWith(ctx, o, prefix, method, params, result) int` with `call` calling it with an empty prefix; on failure in text mode it prints `ork: PREFIX + message` through the same `o.fail` path, and in JSON mode it is `failErr` unchanged. Keep `call`'s stale-daemon and behind-notice `finish` behaviour.
3. `internal/cli/run.go` and `wave.go`: both `ask` closures read with `readLine(reader, prompts)`; `askSpecQuestions` reads with `readLine(in, w)` and keeps its `err == nil` blank line; `specCheck` calls `daemon.MethodSpecCheck` through `callWith(..., "spec check failed: ", ...)`; question title, option, reason and text lines go through `wrapLines(line, 80, "  ")` before printing; `ork run` normalises `held` to `[]string{}` and prints `map[string]any{"started": false, "held": held}` in both decline branches.
4. `internal/cli/adj.go`: print the record title and each option's label and summary through `plainLine`; read the answer with `readLine(reader, prompts)`.
5. `internal/cli/upgrade.go`: `var acceptedContracts = roles.AcceptedContracts` and use it in `contractDirection` and `acceptedList`; reasons `older than the versions ork accepts` and `newer than the versions ork accepts`; `reason = "requested with --upgrade"` plus ` (installed: VERSION)` for slicer and adj when `Version` is not empty; the ork note `ORK_CHECKOUT = your checkout`; the venv hint note given in the tests.
6. Docs: `docs/design.md` (rewrap the two usage lines to 80 columns, keep their words; the `ork run --json` sentence at :1227 now reads `{"started":false,"held":[]}`; add the reason wording and the venv note to the S178 paragraph), `docs/guide.md:236-238`.
7. Run the new tests, then `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/cli`. Existing tests that feed input without a trailing newline now see one more `\n` in the output; fix only those expectations.
8. `CHANGELOG.md`, last (so a parallel slice's entry does not conflict): add one entry at the top of `## Unreleased` that lists the user-visible changes (doctor wording, run JSON `held`, spec-check error prefix, wrapped questions, filtered adj text, newline at end of input). Mark behaviour beyond the roadmap *proposed*.
9. Do not touch: `internal/engine`, `internal/daemon`, `cmd`, `internal/roles`, `internal/adjcli`, `internal/cli/cli.go`. Do not change the JSON shape of `doctor`.

UI slice: UI pass (r14).

Press ctrl-D at the first answer: `held:` starts on its own line.
